help.start:
Getting started

Create a project with File → New project, or open one with File → Open project. Select a component in the Components panel to open its tab.

Open Keyboard shortcuts for command hints. This guide is built into the app and works offline.
help.project:
Projects and components

A project is stored in a folder with project.cpress and its resources. Save changes with Save document or Save all.

Add components from File → Add component. The right panel shows the selected component properties; double-click a component to open it on the canvas.
help.canvas:
Canvas and elements

Select an element on the canvas or in the layer panel to edit its name, position, size, and rotation in Properties. Drag elements with the mouse; use the toolbar tools to add text, images, and shapes.

Group elements, change their order, or lock them. Edit numeric properties for precise placement.
help.data:
Excel data and print modes

For a data-backed component, choose the Excel workbook and sheet in component properties. Save changes in Excel, then choose Refresh data and validate project to reload the workbook.

The top switch selects Prod or Test. Test uses test rows; Prod uses production data. Check both modes before producing print files.
help.build:
Validation and export

Before export, run Refresh data and validate project and resolve errors in the Events panel. Use Validate active component to check one component.

Build menu commands create a PNG ZIP or PDF. You can cancel while a job is running; wait for the completion message before opening its result.
help.recovery:
Archives and restore

Project version archive saves a snapshot. To restore one, import the archive into a separate folder with File → Import → Import project archive, then open the restored project.

Do not extract over the current project. A separate folder preserves the original files and lets you inspect the restored version.
help.troubleshoot:
Troubleshooting and report

If an operation fails, save the project and repeat validation. The Events panel shows messages from the current run.

Use Help → Create error report to create a ZIP. It includes technical logs from the current session and the last reliably detected crashed session. The report excludes project contents; review the ZIP before sharing it.
help.hotkeys:
Keyboard shortcuts

  • Ctrl+N — new project
  • Ctrl+O — open project
  • Ctrl+S — save document
  • Ctrl+Shift+S — save all
  • Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y — undo / redo
  • Delete — delete selected elements
  • Ctrl+G / Ctrl+Shift+G — group / ungroup
  • Ctrl+0 / Ctrl+1 — fit canvas / 100% zoom
  • F1 — open the guide
  • Ctrl+B / Ctrl+Shift+B — build project / active component
